subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**company**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Company** means **being with someone or something.**

 
 
• **Example**: *My friends gave me **company **during my work trip. *
 
 
 
• In this passage, company denotes being along with nature.</li&g
